en: You fail an important exam.
ph_ar: رسبت في امتحان مهم وتحطمت
ph_en: I failed an important exam and I'm crushed

en: You cannot decide which university major to choose.
ph_ar: محتار أي تخصص نختار في الجامعة
ph_en: I can't decide what to study at university

en: You struggle to understand a school subject.
ph_ar: المادة هذي ما فهمت فيها شي
ph_en: I just don't understand this subject no matter what I do

en: You put off studying until the last moment.
ph_ar: نأجل المراجعة لآخر لحظة كل مرة
ph_en: I always leave studying until the last minute

en: Your work is accused of cheating although you did it yourself.
ph_ar: اتهموني بالغش وأنا عملت البحث بروحي
ph_en: They accused me of cheating on work I did myself

en: You see a classmate cheating and do not know what to do.
ph_ar: شفت زميلي يغش ومحتار نقول ولا نسكت
ph_en: I saw a classmate cheating and don't know if I should report it

en: You get a lower result than you expected.
ph_ar: جبت نتيجة أقل من اللي توقعتها
ph_en: My grades were much lower than I expected

en: You feel your classmates are moving ahead faster than you.
ph_ar: حاسس زملائي سابقيني بمراحل
ph_en: Everyone in my class is ahead of me

en: You have to combine study and work.
ph_ar: نقرا ونخدم في نفس الوقت وتعبت
ph_en: Studying and working at the same time is draining me

en: You lose the enthusiasm to learn a skill you started.
ph_ar: بديت نتعلم حاجة وطاحت عزيمتي
ph_en: I lost motivation for a skill I started learning

en: You stutter while giving a presentation in front of the class.
ph_ar: تلخبطت وأنا نقدم العرض قدام القسم
ph_en: I froze and stuttered during my class presentation

en: Your teacher refuses a request you consider reasonable.
ph_ar: الأستاذ رفض طلبي رغم أنه معقول
ph_en: My teacher refused a reasonable request

en: You lose project files just before the deadline.
ph_ar: ضاعوا ملفات المشروع قبل التسليم بيوم
ph_en: I lost all my project files the day before the deadline

en: You receive a scholarship that requires travelling abroad.
ph_ar: جاتني منحة برا ومحتار نسافر ولا لا
ph_en: I got a scholarship abroad and I'm not sure whether to go

en: You go back to studying after a long break.
ph_ar: رجعت نقرا بعد سنين وخايف ما نقدرش
ph_en: I'm going back to school after years and I'm nervous

en: You disagree with your study group about dividing the tasks.
ph_ar: الفريق ما يخدمش وأنا اللي نعمل كل شي
ph_en: My group project partners aren't doing their share

en: You are afraid to ask a question so as not to look slow.
ph_ar: نحشم نسأل باش ما يقولوش ما فهمش
ph_en: I'm afraid to ask questions in class in case I look stupid

en: You discover the major you chose does not suit you.
ph_ar: اكتشفت أن التخصص اللي اخترته ما يناسبنيش
ph_en: I realised my major isn't right for me

en: You are learning a new language and your mistakes embarrass you.
ph_ar: نتعلم لغة جديدة ونحشم من أخطائي
ph_en: I'm learning a new language and my mistakes embarrass me

en: You succeed after repeated failures.
ph_ar: نجحت أخيرًا بعد ما فشلت برشا مرات
ph_en: I finally passed after failing so many times

en: Your debts keep piling up.
ph_ar: الديون تراكمت علي وما عرفتش كيفاش نخلصها
ph_en: My debts keep piling up and I can't see a way out

en: You face an emergency expense you did not plan for.
ph_ar: طاحت علي مصاريف طارئة ما كنتش عامل حسابها
ph_en: An unexpected expense came up and I don't have the money

en: You lend someone money and they do not repay it on time.
ph_ar: سلّفته فلوس وما رجعهمش في الوقت
ph_en: I lent him money and he hasn't paid me back

en: You lose your wallet with important papers in it.
ph_ar: ضاع لي البزطام وفيه الأوراق المهمة
ph_en: I lost my wallet with all my important documents

en: You buy something and then realise you do not need it.
ph_ar: شريت حاجة غالية وما كنتش محتاجها
ph_en: I bought something expensive I didn't need and regret it

en: You fall victim to financial fraud.
ph_ar: تنصبوا علي وأخذوا فلوسي
ph_en: I got scammed and lost my money

en: You disagree with someone about an amount owed.
ph_ar: تخاصمنا على مبلغ هو يقول خلصتو وأنا نقول لا
ph_en: We're arguing over how much money is still owed

en: You cannot pay the rent on time.
ph_ar: ما نقدرش نخلص الكراء هالشهر
ph_en: I can't pay the rent this month

en: You need to cut expenses and do not know where to start.
ph_ar: لازم ننقص المصاريف وما نعرفش منين نبدا
ph_en: I need to cut back on spending and don't know where to start

en: Someone offers you a profit opportunity that seems unrealistic.
ph_ar: واحد عرض علي مشروع ربح سريع يبان مش معقول
ph_en: Someone offered me a get-rich-quick deal that sounds too good to be true

en: You compare your financial situation with people richer than you.
ph_ar: نقارن روحي باللي عندهم فلوس أكثر مني
ph_en: I keep comparing myself to people who have more money

en: You hesitate between saving and fulfilling a personal wish.
ph_ar: محتار نوفّر الفلوس ولا نشري اللي نحبو
ph_en: I can't decide whether to save or treat myself

en: You receive unexpected money and do not know how to use it.
ph_ar: جاتني فلوس ما كنتش متوقعها ومحتار فيهم
ph_en: I got some unexpected money and don't know what to do with it

en: A small business you started fails.
ph_ar: المشروع الصغير اللي بديتو فشل
ph_en: The small business I started has failed

en: Someone asks you to guarantee their loan.
ph_ar: صاحبي طالب مني نكون ضامن في قرضه
ph_en: A friend asked me to be the guarantor on his loan

en: An essential tool you rely on for work breaks down.
ph_ar: تكسرت الآلة اللي نخدم بيها
ph_en: The equipment I need for my job broke down

en: You find money transferred to your account by mistake.
ph_ar: لقيت فلوس في حسابي حولوها غلط
ph_en: Someone transferred money to my account by mistake

en: The cost of living rises while your income stays the same.
ph_ar: كل شي غلى والشهرية كيما هي
ph_en: Everything is getting more expensive but my income stays the same

en: You feel ashamed that you cannot keep up with your friends' spending.
ph_ar: نحشم مع صحابي خاطر ما نقدرش نصرف كيفهم
ph_en: I'm embarrassed I can't afford to go out like my friends do

en: You reach a financial goal after a long period of discipline.
ph_ar: وصلت للمبلغ اللي كنت نجمع فيه سنين
ph_en: I finally reached my savings goal after years

en: You receive a medical diagnosis you did not expect.
ph_ar: الطبيب قالي عندي مرض ما كنتش متوقعو
ph_en: The doctor gave me a diagnosis I wasn't expecting

en: You are waiting for test results and feel anxious.
ph_ar: نستنى في نتيجة التحاليل وقلبي يدق
ph_en: I'm anxious waiting for my test results

en: Someone dear to you falls ill.
ph_ar: أمي مرضت ومش قادر نشوفها هكا
ph_en: Someone I love is seriously ill

en: You lose a relative or a friend.
ph_ar: مات صاحبي العزيز
ph_en: I lost a dear friend

en: You struggle to return to life after losing someone you love.
ph_ar: من وقت ما مات بابا ما رجعتش لروحي
ph_en: Since my father died I can't get back to normal life

en: You suffer from insomnia that affects your day.
ph_ar: ما نرقدش في الليل ونهاري كامل مدمّر
ph_en: I can't sleep at night and it's ruining my days

en: You feel a constant sadness you cannot describe.
ph_ar: فيا حزن ما نعرفش منين جاي
ph_en: I feel a constant sadness I can't explain

en: You have a sudden panic attack.
ph_ar: جاتني نوبة هلع فجأة وقلبي ولّى يدق بقوة
ph_en: I had a sudden panic attack out of nowhere

en: You are temporarily unable to do an activity you loved.
ph_ar: بعد الإصابة ما عادش نقدر نلعب الكورة
ph_en: After my injury I can't do the sport I love

en: You need psychological support but hesitate to ask for it.
ph_ar: محتاج نشوف طبيب نفسي بس متردد
ph_en: I think I need a therapist but I'm hesitant

en: Your changed appearance after an illness or injury affects you.
ph_ar: شكلي تبدل بعد المرض وما عادش نحب نشوف روحي
ph_en: My appearance changed after the illness and I hate it

en: Caring for a sick person exhausts you and you feel guilty for being tired.
ph_ar: تعبت من رعاية أمي المريضة ونحس بالذنب خاطر تعبت
ph_en: I'm exhausted caring for my sick mother and feel guilty about it

en: You are recovering slowly but rush to return to your activities.
ph_ar: نتعافى بشوية بشوية وأنا مستعجل نرجع
ph_en: I'm recovering slowly and I'm impatient to get back to normal

en: You hear a comment that belittles your suffering.
ph_ar: قالولي اللي فيك موش حاجة
ph_en: People keep telling me my pain is no big deal

en: You worry about your health because of things you read online.
ph_ar: قريت على النت وولّيت نخاف عندي مرض خطير
ph_en: I read things online and now I'm convinced I'm seriously ill

en: You feel others do not understand your grief.
ph_ar: حتى حد ما فاهم حزني
ph_en: No one understands my sadness

en: You have to postpone an important plan for health reasons.
ph_ar: أجلت مشروعي بسبب صحتي
ph_en: I had to put my plans on hold because of my health

en: You are trying to change a habit that harms your health and keep slipping.
ph_ar: نحاول نبطل التدخين ونرجعلو
ph_en: I keep trying to quit smoking and failing

en: You notice that life's pressure is affecting your relationships.
ph_ar: الضغط خلاني نتعصب على كل اللي حولي
ph_en: Stress is ruining my relationships with everyone around me

en: You feel relief after sharing your worry with someone you trust.
ph_ar: ارتحت كي حكيت همي لصاحبي
ph_en: I felt so much lighter after opening up to a friend
